text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Wonder Acute and I are
walking
down the hall on our way to
training...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I just have a bit of a headache.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me. I'll rub a pickled
plum on
my temple and have this fixed
up in no time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You go on ahead. I'll catch up in
a—uuegh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute is struggling with
a
migraine.
